strategy.success_criterion: On the buggy revision 52e053991b6a built with clang UBSAN, the test process aborts with an UBSAN report of float-to-integer conversion out of range (for n = nan) followed by an illegal instruction crash, so the test fails. On the fixed revision the same test runs to completion with no UBSAN report and no crash, and all parametrizations pass.

input_output_examples.buggy_output: illegal conversion of n to an integer; UBSAN undefined behavior report and illegal instruction crash
input_output_examples.expected_output: no undefined behavior and no crash; API unchanged

risks: Reproduction requires clang with UBSAN; the transition will not occur on a GCC build or without -fsanitize=undefined, since the NaN-to-integer cast is not trapped otherwise.
The exact UBSAN flags are not given in the evidence; the build flags above are inferred and may need adjustment for the scipy meson build.

The fixed revision's NaN result value is not specified in the evidence; the test only asserts no crash and the existing test assertions, so the pass depends on those existing assertions holding for NaN.
Reviewer concern about casting double to Py_ssize_t remains unresolved, so the fix's exact behaviour for n = nan beyond avoiding UB is not verified.

Platform dependence: float-to-integer UB may manifest differently on different architectures (x86 cvttsd2si yields INT_MIN without trapping), so the illegal-instruction symptom may only appear under specific sanitizer and architecture combinations; on other platforms the test may pass on the buggy revision too.
Full scipy build from source is long and may fail on missing system dependencies.

strategy.fails_on_buggy: Under UBSAN the NaN-to-long-long cast in eval_gegenbauer triggers an undefined-behavior report and an illegal instruction trap, aborting the pytest process so the test does not complete, which counts as failure.
strategy.passes_on_fixed: The fixed code checks n >= 0 and n < 1e10 before the cast, so NaN never reaches the integer conversion; the test completes with no UBSAN report and all parametrized assertions pass.
